title: MK-Ultra Craft
subtitle: Test your understanding of MK-Ultra Craft — how manufactured choice, emotional scoring, severe trauma, and gifted pipelines steer consent inside the Sovereign Accord.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: MK-Ultra Craft keeps containment inside the Sovereign Accord by manufacturing choices, emotional states, and desires until people accept their own subjugation. Public broadcasts and emotional scoring prime brain chemistry, severe trauma installs compartmentalized alters, and institutional gifted programs quietly harvest high-intelligence youth. Disposable public violence supplies the outrage used to disarm civilians, while designed noise lowers the cognitive baseline and blocks mass awakening.

questions.question: The Sovereign Accord governs energetic interventions by establishing which fundamental field law?

options.label: A
options.text: No field shall be overridden from outside itself once coherent structures have self-sustained harmonics within.
options.rationale: The Sovereign Accord requires human choice and consent for all interventions once those harmonics are in place.

options.label: B
options.text: External fields possess an inherent right to reorganize any chaotic internal structure they encounter.
options.rationale: The Sovereign Accord does not grant outside fields a right to reorganize a coherent structure.

options.label: C
options.text: Conscious awareness alone is enough for an external field to begin an override of a living structure.
options.rationale: Awareness is not the threshold. The Accord requires human choice and consent for all interventions.

options.label: D
options.text: Harmonic resonance must be locked to institutional frequencies before any stable structure is allowed to persist.
options.rationale: Institutional frequency lock is not the field law. The law bars outside override without consent.

questions.hint: Consider the requirement for internal consent versus an external override.

questions.question: What is the primary operational objective of Public MK-Ultra broadcasts?

options.label: A
options.text: Public MK-Ultra is broadcast through cultural media to prime brain chemistry and direct collective behavior.
options.rationale: Television, cinema, radio, and cultural media carry this mass-market conditioning into the population.

options.label: B
options.text: Public MK-Ultra selects named individuals for immediate removal into underground facilities during the broadcast.
options.rationale: Mass broadcasts target the general population. Extraction of high-intelligence youth runs through gifted pipelines.

options.label: C
options.text: Public MK-Ultra supplies a neutral stage where diverse artistic traditions can circulate without a behavioral aim.
options.rationale: Mainstream entertainment functions as an active delivery mechanism engineered to alter brain chemistry.

options.label: D
options.text: Public MK-Ultra exists to deliver classroom lessons that raise the collective intelligence of the whole population.
options.rationale: These broadcasts prime brain chemistry and direct collective behavior. They are not a literacy program.

questions.hint: Focus on mass-market media and what it does to brain chemistry and collective behavior.

questions.question: How does Emotional Scoring manipulate human vulnerability?

options.label: A
options.text: Emotional Scoring lays down a rhythmic baseline whose job is to encourage critical thinking and independent logic.
options.rationale: The scoring primes vulnerability and emotional states. It is not a tool for independent logic.

options.label: B
options.text: Emotional Scoring uses precise frequency arrangements that dictate how an individual interprets reality.
options.rationale: Musical compositions are precise frequency arrangements designed to prime the human subconscious.

options.label: C
options.text: Emotional Scoring flattens every frequency to one standard level so extreme emotional spikes cannot occur.
options.rationale: Scoring dictates emotional states. It does not flatten contrast or protect the listener from spikes.

options.label: D
options.text: Emotional Scoring asks composers to reveal an authentic private mood so audiences feel a genuine human bond.
options.rationale: These compositions are engineered acoustic tools. They are not left as private artistic confession.

questions.hint: Think about acoustic patterns and how they steer interpretation of reality.

questions.question: In sad scene mechanics, which musical phrasing is used to mimic a vocal sigh or moan?

options.label: A
options.text: Notes employ legato phrasing gliding smoothly without sharp breaks to resemble a vocal sigh or moan.
options.rationale: Slow adagio or largo tempos keep that legato line hushed, dark, and muted.

options.label: B
options.text: Percussive strikes that accent the downbeat of every measure are used to imitate a human sigh or moan.
options.rationale: Forceful percussion belongs to action scoring. Sad phrasing glides smoothly without sharp breaks.

options.label: C
options.text: Arpeggiated chords that rapidly cycle through high and low ranges are used to imitate a weeping voice.
options.rationale: Sad scenes do not rely on rapid arpeggiated cycling. They use legato phrasing that glides without sharp breaks.

options.label: D
options.text: Staccato notes with a sharp rhythmic gap between every tone are used to imitate a vocal sigh or moan.
options.rationale: Sharp breaks cut against the sigh. Legato phrasing glides smoothly without those breaks.

questions.hint: Look for smooth, connected notes rather than sharp rhythmic breaks.

questions.question: Which instruments are specifically chosen to signal absolute tragedy in the acoustic palette?

options.label: A
options.text: Reedy woodwinds like the oboe, English horn, and Armenian duduk signal absolute tragedy.
options.rationale: These reedy woodwinds are chosen for their resonance with the human voice at the point of absolute tragedy.

options.label: B
options.text: The solo violin played with heavy vibrato is the instrument reserved to signal absolute tragedy.
options.rationale: The solo violin creates a fragile piercing sound akin to a voice cracking with emotion. Absolute tragedy is assigned to reedy woodwinds.

options.label: C
options.text: Sparse echoing piano notes are reserved as the dedicated signal of absolute tragedy.
options.rationale: Sparse echoing piano notes convey isolation and nostalgia. They are not the signal of absolute tragedy.

options.label: D
options.text: The cello and its deep woody register are reserved as the sole signal of absolute tragedy.
options.rationale: The cello matches low-frequency somber vocalizations. Absolute tragedy is signaled by the oboe, English horn, and Armenian duduk.

questions.hint: Identify the reedy woodwinds named for that role.

questions.question: The G.A.T. Programs were established in the wake of which geopolitical event?

options.label: A
options.text: The end of World War II supplied the pretext for a global multilingual workforce inside public schools.
options.rationale: The pipeline follows the Sputnik Shock of 1957. It is not framed as an immediate postwar workforce plan.

options.label: B
options.text: The signing of the Sovereign Accord supplied the pretext for new consent protocols inside public schools.
options.rationale: The Sovereign Accord is a field law. G.A.T. Programs were initiated following the Sputnik Shock of 1957.

options.label: C
options.text: The widespread establishment of G.A.T. Programs was initiated following the Sputnik Shock of 1957.
options.rationale: The perceived threat of the Soviet satellite launch served as a manufactured Problem-Reaction-Solution mechanism.

options.label: D
options.text: The Apollo Moon Landing supplied the pretext for a new generation of lunar scientists inside public schools.
options.rationale: G.A.T. Programs were initiated following the Sputnik Shock of 1957, not a later lunar landing.

questions.hint: Look for a 1957 event involving a Soviet satellite.

questions.question: What is the primary mechanism behind the Problem-Reaction-Solution framework?

options.label: A
options.text: The public is handed several remedies for a genuine crisis and then allowed to vote the remedy into law, without a larger engineered system underneath.
options.rationale: The implementation is pre-planned. The framework does not wait on an open public vote.

options.label: B
options.text: Existing social problems are named in public and then solved through an open search for the most efficient fix, stopping the explanation at that boundary alone.
options.rationale: The framework manufactures or fakes a crisis. It is not an open search for an efficient fix.

options.label: C
options.text: A public reaction is provoked before any problem exists so controllers can measure civilian resilience, without a larger engineered system underneath.
options.rationale: The crisis comes first. It is manufactured or faked to provoke a predictable public outcry.

options.label: D
options.text: A crisis is manufactured or faked to provoke a predictable public outcry justifying a pre-planned legislative or operational implementation.
options.rationale: The outcry is the reaction that makes the pre-planned implementation look like a public demand.

questions.hint: Consider how a staged crisis can drive a legislative or operational result.

questions.question: Severe MK-Ultra conditioning relies on which psychological defense mechanism to create alter-personalities?

options.label: A
options.text: Confirmation bias lets the victim keep only the gratification memories and discard every abusive episode.
options.rationale: The compartments are structural alters separated by amnesic barriers, not a preference for pleasant memories.

options.label: B
options.text: Sensory deprivation alone causes the brain to hallucinate replacement identities that fill an empty room.
options.rationale: Alter-personalities come from mind compartmentalization induced through severe trauma, not from deprivation alone.

options.label: C
options.text: Cognitive dissonance lets the victim refuse the trauma until a second belief system replaces the first.
options.rationale: The split is mind compartmentalization with amnesic barriers, not a clash between two ordinary beliefs.

options.label: D
options.text: Distinct alter-personalities are created in isolated mental compartments accessible via specific trigger cues.
options.rationale: Severe trauma induces mind compartmentalization and separates those alters by psychological amnesic barriers.

questions.hint: Focus on the split of consciousness into isolated parts.

questions.question: What distinguishes a single-use disposable killer among operational assets?

options.label: A
options.text: High-intelligence children scout neighborhoods for the G.A.T. pipeline and then return to ordinary classrooms, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: Disposable killers are activated victims of a violent act. They are not talent scouts for gifted programs.

options.label: B
options.text: Activated victims perform a single high-visibility violent act with the explicit expectation that they will be apprehended or killed.
options.rationale: These single-use MK-Ultra victims generate intense public fear that drives legislative changes such as weapon bans.

options.label: C
options.text: Elite assassins repeat high-level missions across several decades and are preserved after every assignment, without a larger engineered system underneath.
options.rationale: A disposable killer is built for one high-visibility act and is expected to be apprehended or killed.

options.label: D
options.text: Unseen stealth agents complete covert clean-up work and leave the scene without any public broadcast, with no further layer required beyond that account.
options.rationale: Disposable killers are tasked with high-profile violent acts. Their visibility is the point of the operation.

questions.hint: Think about a mission that is meant to end in capture or death.

questions.question: Why does MK-Ultra media cycle viewers through contrasting emotions such as happy, sad, cute, and funny?

options.label: A
options.text: The cycle tests which emotional genre the audience prefers so later commercials can be sorted by taste.
options.rationale: The aim is to erode internal emotional stability and instill pre-designed behavioral responses.

options.label: B
options.text: Media broadcasts erode internal emotional stability and instill pre-designed behavioral responses.
options.rationale: They do this by rapidly cycling viewers through contrasting emotional sequences of happy, sad, cute, and funny scenes.

options.label: C
options.text: The cycle offers a rounded entertainment experience that copies the variety of ordinary life.
options.rationale: The sequences are an active delivery mechanism engineered to alter brain chemistry, not a portrait of ordinary life.

options.label: D
options.text: The cycle gives the viewer scheduled recovery time between intense blocks of information.
options.rationale: The cycle erodes internal emotional stability. It is not inserted as recovery time.

questions.hint: Consider what rapid emotional shifting does to internal stability.

questions.question: What does the Gratification Phase do after intense abuse in severe trauma protocols?

options.label: A
options.text: Following intense abuse, victims are removed from isolation and showered with fake love, sweet foods, ice cream, toys, cartoons, and clean clothing.
options.rationale: That artificial affection is the other pole of a cycle of extreme violence and artificial affection.

options.label: B
options.text: The victim is drilled in the manners and skills required to operate inside high-society rooms, without a larger engineered system underneath.
options.rationale: The phase uses fake love, sweet foods, ice cream, toys, cartoons, and clean clothing, not high-society job training.

options.label: C
options.text: The victim is coached for a return to the elite tier of the public education system, without a larger engineered system underneath.
options.rationale: Gratification stays inside the trauma cycle. It is not a handover back to a public school elite tier.

options.label: D
options.text: The victim receives genuine healing of psychic wounds before the next round of training is allowed to start, with no further layer required beyond that account.
options.rationale: The affection is fake love inside a programming cycle. It is not genuine healing of the abuse.

questions.hint: Think about what follows the trauma phase inside the same oscillation.

questions.question: Which acoustic element is used to trigger adrenaline and mimic a racing heartbeat?

options.label: A
options.text: Action scores utilize booming heavy percussion, including timpani, taiko drums, and struck metal anvils, to mimic a racing heartbeat or aggressive footsteps.
options.rationale: That percussion is built to trigger physical tension, panic, and adrenaline spikes.

options.label: B
options.text: High-tension string sections bowed close to the bridge produce the rhythmic pulse of a racing heartbeat, stopping the explanation at that boundary alone.
options.rationale: Those strings produce a raspy glassy noise that heightens anxiety. Heartbeat mimicry belongs to booming heavy percussion.

options.label: C
options.text: Low brass such as trombones tubas and French horns blown cuivré supply the racing-heartbeat layer, stopping the explanation at that boundary alone.
options.rationale: That brass is blown aggressively to project menacing power. Booming heavy percussion mimics the racing heartbeat.

options.label: D
options.text: Low-frequency synthesizers and sub-bass drones are the element that copies a racing heartbeat, stopping the explanation at that boundary alone.
options.rationale: Sub-bass drones vibrate physical spaces to induce a primal sense of dread. They are not the heartbeat layer.

questions.hint: Look for the drums and metal strikes inside action scores.

questions.question: The 1958 National Defense Education Act was designed to accomplish which hidden goal?

options.label: A
options.text: The Act was written to fund arts and humanities as a shield against ideological shifts among youth, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: The public guise was scientific and mathematical education, used to identify exceptional intelligence.

options.label: B
options.text: The Act was written so every child in the nation would receive the same level of scientific literacy, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: The framework targets children of exceptional intelligence and problem-solving capability, not a uniform level for every child.

options.label: C
options.text: This framework was created to systematically identify children of exceptional intelligence and problem-solving capability.
options.rationale: Identified candidates are extracted into specialized pipelines for black-budget training as early as kindergarten or third grade.

options.label: D
options.text: The Act was written to prepare the civilian population for a ground invasion by Soviet forces, as if no adjacent systems participated at all.
options.rationale: The Act funded a school framework to identify exceptional intelligence. It was not civilian invasion drill.

questions.hint: Think about how federal school funding was used to screen children.

questions.question: What role do Jason Bourne level assets play in the MK-Ultra hierarchy?

options.label: A
options.text: They are broad-market media personalities hired to deliver Public MK-Ultra messaging on schedule, held as a complete closed account of the events.
options.rationale: These assets are stealth operatives and multilingual killers, not public media personalities.

options.label: B
options.text: They are the primary programmers who run trauma phases inside underground facilities, without a larger engineered system underneath.
options.rationale: Jason Bourne level assets are the operatives produced by the pipelines, not the programmers who run the trauma.

options.label: C
options.text: They are disposable assets sent to trigger immediate emotional outrage and then be lost on camera, keeping every neighboring mechanism off the board.
options.rationale: Immediate public sacrifice describes single-use disposable killers, not Jason Bourne level assets.

options.label: D
options.text: Multi-disciplinary highly intelligent stealth operatives and multilingual killers selected directly from early-childhood G.A.T.
options.rationale: That tier sits above single-use disposable killers and is built for complex covert work.

questions.hint: Recall the elite operatives drawn from early-childhood gifted pipelines.

questions.question: In the Hungerford Massacre case, what was the primary purpose of the orchestrated media panic?

options.label: A
options.text: The panic was staged to drive sales of high-tech security systems for primary school buildings, and declining any account that reaches past that point.
options.rationale: The operational result was a ban on civilian handgun ownership, not a commercial security campaign.

options.label: B
options.text: The panic was staged to identify which bystanders would remain calm under extreme public stress, without extending the chain into harvest or inversion logistics.
options.rationale: The coverage was orchestrated to generate overwhelming public panic and grief, not to score individual calm.

options.label: C
options.text: The panic was staged so the public would arm itself more heavily against the next similar event, with the surrounding architecture waved away as irrelevant.
options.rationale: The leverage was used to ban civilian handgun ownership and disarm the populace, not to expand civilian arms.

options.label: D
options.text: The resulting media coverage was orchestrated to generate overwhelming public panic and grief providing the necessary emotional leverage for the government to ban civilian handgun ownership.
options.rationale: Michael Ryan was an activated MK-Ultra asset directed to commit a public shooting at a primary school.

questions.hint: Consider the long-term objective of disarming the civilian population.

questions.question: How does MK-Ultra Craft secure compliance while adhering to the Sovereign Accord?

options.label: A
options.text: The system functions by manufacturing choices, emotional states, and desires.
options.rationale: Societal containment is maintained through manufactured human choice rather than direct overt field overrides.

options.label: B
options.text: Compliance is secured by isolating human consciousness from every external frequency and acoustic signal.
options.rationale: Compliance is manufactured through choices and emotional states. Isolation is a trauma tactic, not this public method.

options.label: C
options.text: Compliance is secured by overwhelming physical force that suppresses any internal resistance to the field.
options.rationale: Direct outside override is what the Sovereign Accord forbids. The craft manufactures choice instead.

options.label: D
options.text: Compliance is secured by telling every person the full conditioning protocol before any broadcast begins.
options.rationale: The craft manufactures choices, emotional states, and desires. It does not open with a full disclosure of the protocol.

questions.hint: Think about how wants are steered so the override never has to come from outside.

questions.question: What does designed background noise do inside public MK-Ultra conditioning?

options.label: A
options.text: Designed background noise is unintentional static from aging broadcast towers and satellite dishes, held as a complete closed account of the events.
options.rationale: The noise is designed. It is a constant influx of external stimuli, not a broken transmitter.

options.label: B
options.text: Designed background noise is a constant influx of external stimuli that consumes mental bandwidth and diminishes the opportunity for internal thought or spiritual balance.
options.rationale: That swamping is how public visual and auditory conditioning keeps consciousness occupied.

options.label: C
options.text: Designed background noise is the inner voice of a victim trying to resist programming during trauma, as if no adjacent systems participated at all.
options.rationale: The noise is external stimuli that consume mental bandwidth. It is not the victim inner voice.

options.label: D
options.text: Designed background noise is a facility-only tone used underground to block prisoner communication, as if no adjacent systems participated at all.
options.rationale: In public conditioning the noise swamps consciousness at broadcast scale. It is not limited to a prison intercom.

questions.hint: Reflect on a constant influx of stimuli and what it leaves for inner thought.

questions.question: Which bowing technique creates a raspy glassy noise to heighten anxiety in high-tension scenes?

options.label: A
options.text: High-tension scenes feature screeching string sections played sul ponticello to produce a raspy glassy noise that heightens anxiety.
options.rationale: Sul ponticello means bowing close to the bridge, which yields that raspy glassy timbre.

options.label: B
options.text: Heavy vibrato on the string section creates the raspy glassy noise used to heighten anxiety, as if no adjacent systems participated at all.
options.rationale: Heavy vibrato belongs to the fragile solo violin. High-tension raspy noise is sul ponticello.

options.label: C
options.text: Legato bowing across the string section creates the raspy glassy noise used to heighten anxiety, without a larger engineered system underneath.
options.rationale: Legato phrasing resembles a vocal sigh. The raspy glassy anxiety noise is sul ponticello.

options.label: D
options.text: Pizzicato plucks on the string section create the raspy glassy noise used to heighten anxiety, stopping the explanation at that boundary alone.
options.rationale: The raspy glassy noise comes from sul ponticello bowing close to the bridge, not from plucked strings.

questions.hint: Identify the technique that bows close to the bridge.

questions.question: What is the function of low-frequency synthesizers and sub-bass drones in media?

options.label: A
options.text: They clear the auditory field so spoken dialogue can be heard with less competition from the score.
options.rationale: The drones are added to vibrate physical spaces and induce dread. They do not clear the field for dialogue.

options.label: B
options.text: They imitate natural ambience and soothe the viewer once a violent scene has finished, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: These drones induce a primal sense of dread. They are not a soothing nature bed.

options.label: C
options.text: Low-frequency synthesizers and sub-bass drones vibrate physical spaces to induce a primal sense of dread.
options.rationale: That dread layer sits under the screeching strings in high-tension scenes.

options.label: D
options.text: They supply a melodic hook so the audience remembers the commercial product after the scene ends.
options.rationale: Sub-bass drones vibrate physical spaces to induce a primal sense of dread. They are not a product jingle.

questions.hint: Focus on the physical sensation of very low frequencies.

questions.question: Why is the trauma-gratification cycle repeated systematically over several years in the Montauk protocols?

options.label: A
options.text: The cycle is repeated so the victim stays in a state of rising intelligence throughout adolescence, with no further layer required beyond that account.
options.rationale: The cycle forces mind compartmentalization. High intelligence is harvested separately through G.A.T. pipelines.

options.label: B
options.text: Severe abuse forces the mind of certain victims to form mind compartmentalization as the cycle of extreme violence and artificial affection is repeated systematically over several years.
options.rationale: Programmers then install distinct alter-personalities that remain dormant until activated by a remote trigger.

options.label: C
options.text: The cycle is repeated to learn which hallucinogenic drugs best preserve one unbroken persona, and declining any account that reaches past that point.
options.rationale: The abuse is meant to shatter psychic cohesion and form mind compartmentalization, not to preserve one persona.

options.label: D
options.text: The cycle is repeated to build physical endurance for high-stress environmental missions, and declining any account that reaches past that point.
options.rationale: The stated result is mind compartmentalization and triggered alters, not a physical fitness program.

questions.hint: Consider the long-term split of one consciousness into triggered compartments.

questions.question: How are alter-personalities in a compartmentalized mind typically activated?

options.label: A
options.text: Programmers install acoustic or verbal triggers such as a specific phrase spoken over a telephone or a particular song played over the radio.
options.rationale: Those triggers instantly switch specific alter-personalities on or off and activate the victim for covert missions.

options.label: B
options.text: Activation happens only when the victim is returned to the original facility where the trauma occurred, with no further layer required beyond that account.
options.rationale: A phrase over a telephone or a song over the radio can switch alters on or off away from the facility.

options.label: C
options.text: Activation arrives when the victim consciously realizes the situation and decides to escape, as if no adjacent systems participated at all.
options.rationale: Psychological amnesic barriers wall the compartments off. Activation is an external acoustic or verbal trigger.

options.label: D
options.text: Activation arrives through a slow practice of meditation and internal reflection led by the victim, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: Triggers instantly switch specific alter-personalities on or off. The switch is not a slow private meditation.

questions.hint: Think about external signals such as words or songs.

questions.question: What is the strategic implication of subjugation via consent?

options.label: A
options.text: Controllers achieve total population management while strictly conforming to the legal requirement of human free-will acceptance under field law.
options.rationale: Subtle priming steers human wants and emotional reactions so the acceptance still counts as choice.

options.label: B
options.text: The population can eventually overrule the controllers through an ordinary democratic reversal, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: Subjugation via consent is built to secure total population management, not to leave a path for overthrow.

options.label: C
options.text: Controllers must constantly renegotiate real power with a civilian population that can refuse them, without a larger engineered system underneath.
options.rationale: The consent is manufactured through priming. It is not an open renegotiation of power.

options.label: D
options.text: The population is pushed to take fuller responsibility for its own psychological health, with no further layer required beyond that account.
options.rationale: The objective is total population management under field law, not a turn toward private psychological responsibility.

questions.hint: Consider how total management continues without breaking field law.

options.text: Teams abduct children directly from households in high-income neighborhoods and skip the schools entirely, held as a complete closed account of the events.

options.label: C
options.text: Youth volunteer for government internships at scientific research centers and are hired from those applications, and declining any account that reaches past that point.
options.rationale: Identification begins as early as kindergarten or third grade inside gifted programs, not through later voluntary internships.

options.label: D
options.text: Social media mining of teenage vocabulary and puzzle scores is the main historical harvesting channel, without a larger engineered system underneath.
options.rationale: The harvesting channel named here is institutional gifted programs and national talent search initiatives.

questions.hint: Look for the gifted programs used as a public screen.

questions.question: What does cognitive bandwidth reduction secure for custodial control structures?

options.label: A
options.text: It builds a shared cultural language that makes global communication simpler and clearer, stopping the explanation at that boundary alone.
options.rationale: The inundation lowers the cognitive baseline and prevents mass awakening. It is not a clarity project.

options.label: B
options.text: It supplies the background frequencies required for the planetary magnetic field to stay stable, stopping the explanation at that boundary alone.
options.rationale: The objective is a lowered human cognitive baseline that prevents mass awakening, not planetary magnetic upkeep.

options.label: C
options.text: The continuous inundation of contrasting emotional media sequences and acoustic frequencies permanently lowers human cognitive baseline preventing mass awakening.
options.rationale: That lowered baseline secures ongoing societal control for custodial structures.

options.label: D
options.text: It lets a government track the exact location of every citizen through hidden audio signals, with no further layer required beyond that account.
options.rationale: Bandwidth reduction lowers the human cognitive baseline. It is not a location-tracking grid.

questions.hint: Consider a permanently lowered baseline and what that does to mass awakening.
